companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text:
GfK – an NIQ Company is a global leader in consumer and market intelligence, providing worldclass insights that help brands and retailers make smarter, faster decisions. Founded in 1923 and headquartered in Nuremberg, Germany, GfK joined forces with NIQ in 2023, forming the world’s leading consumer intelligence powerhouse. 

Together, we deliver The Full View™&#

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text: We are looking for a dynamic and detail-oriented Business Intelligence Associate to join our team. This role is perfect for individuals with a passion for data analytics, reporting, and transforming raw data into actionable insights. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to support clients' reporting needs and contribute to strategic decision-making.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Degree in IT, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related fields. 
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. 
  • Excellent command of English and Mandarin; additional languages are a plus.
